proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of Goj sī̃g “horns” (f_35d4s4gs37uk6). Family evidence: CDIAL 12583 śṛṅga explicitly gives Bshk ṣīṅ, northern ṣiṅga and Hindi sī̃g horn. These singular/plural variants match the horn family with final nasal and glottal details preserved. Reviewed comparison: Goj siŋ “horns” (f_g5tom7s5sgola). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
